description: This file defines a PHPUnit test class HelpConfigServiceTest for testing the HelpConfigService component within the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It includes setup for test data and two test methods to verify configuration retrieval methods.

classes.name: HelpConfigServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for HelpConfigService, verifying configuration retrieval functionalities in the OrangeHRM Help plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of HelpConfigService and populating test data from a fixture YAML file.

methods.name: testGetBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Tests that getBaseHelpUrl() returns the URL 'https://starterhelp.orangehrm.com'.
